name: Thanin Chaiyawat
bio:
Thanin's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent helping his father repair motorcycles. This hands-on experience fueled his pursuit of engineering, leading him to graduate top of his class at Chulalongkorn University. He quickly rose through the ranks at a local tuning shop before securing a position at a smaller racing team. 

His meticulous approach to problem-solving and knack for optimizing performance quickly set him apart. Thanin thrives under pressure, viewing each race as a complex puzzle waiting to be solved. He's known for his innovative solutions and his ability to extract maximum performance from limited resources. His experience in smaller teams has made him a master of resourcefulness, always seeking that extra edge.

Thanin believes in creating a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment within his team. He encourages open communication and fosters a culture of continuous improvement. His leadership style, combined with his technical acumen, make him a highly sought-after technical director in the motorsport world.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: He has a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on checking the torque settings on critical components himself.
